commit_message: Complete ADR0143 resource controls on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0143 on current main while preserving ADR0145 external-agent provider ownership. Local Ollama-compatible ModelBackends expose truthful provider-reported residency telemetry and verified unload/reload/CPU-offload operations. AI Studio releases supported local model residency before explicit Editor restoration and managed Play, and reacquires it only after authoritative-state re-inspection. Hosted API and Enterprise backends keep local GPU controls unavailable, and Claude/Codex external AgentRuntime providers are never treated as ModelBackends. Existing provider-managed authentication, ephemeral MCP injection, canonical-authoring work claims, external process cancellation, diagnostics, and frozen per-run provider selection remain intact.

Deterministic production-boundary tests cover Interrupt-for-Editing release before Editor restore, managed Play RuntimeRendering priority and release, post-inspection Resume reload, and authoring-state-free resource planning. ADR0143 is marked Accepted.

## Validation

Windows Validation: affected. Editor Visual Validation is required on the final exact head.
